notes.content:
Here is a sneak peek picture from our latest build which shows our updated lightning as well as effects and visual style.

notes.title: New cover and new name!
notes.content:
The game is called Ghoststory now.
Here is the new cover of the game.

We hope you like it!
New pictures will be uploaded later today that will show of the new and improved style and graphics of the game.

notes.title: Store page is up! The Elder Gods are pleased.
notes.content:
We welcome you fellow haunters of the dark to "The haunting of Baskerville". The game will be released on april 9th.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32225230/b51964d24d533d1c5bbd9ca39dba8c2da127635e.png[/img]
